title: Custom Printed Tiles in Coimbatore | Elite Balaji
description: Your image printed on vitrified tile: pooja room murals, kitchen backsplashes and feature walls, made to order and delivered across India.
intro: Send us an image and a wall size, and it can be printed across vitrified or ceramic tiles: deity art for a pooja room, a landscape behind the kitchen counter, a heritage pattern recreated, or a shop's own artwork.
We confirm the tile, the size and the layout with you before anything is printed, and we deliver across India.

choose.title: Resolution decides the size
choose.detail: A phone photo prints well up to a certain wall size. Send the image first and we will tell you honestly how large it can go.

choose.title: Plan around the joints
choose.detail: The design is split across tiles, so we place the joints away from faces and focal points.

choose.title: Approve the layout
choose.detail: You see the tile layout before printing starts. Nothing is printed on a guess.

faq.q: Can you print a family photo on tiles?
faq.a: Yes, as long as the image is sharp enough for the wall size. Send it on WhatsApp and we will check it before quoting.
It depends on the size and the tile. We confirm the timeline when we confirm the layout.
Yes, custom art products including printed tiles are delivered across India.
